title.zh: 授权教育部长在Albay省Guinobatan的Roxas纪念农业学校开设大学程度课程，但以该校财产收益允许为条件的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Secretary of Education to Open in the Roxas Memorial Agricultural School at Guinobatan, Albay, Courses of Collegiate Level if the Income of the Properties of Said School so Warrants
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Secretary of Education to Open in the Roxas Memorial Agricultural School at Guinobatan, Albay, Courses of Collegiate Level if the Income of the Properties of Said School so Warrants

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_391_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Secretary of Education, upon the recommendation of the Director of Public Schools, is hereby authorized to open in the Roxas Memorial Agricultural School at Guinobatan, Province of Albay, courses of collegiate level if the income of the properties of said school of warrants.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1949.
